description: Join Reps. Dar’shun Kendrick and Doreen Carter for Pizza & Politics on June 10, 2026. Learn about Georgia’s upcoming Special Session, the Callais redistricting case, and what it means for your community. Ask questions, share perspectives, and stay informed. 🍕🗳️
title: Pizza & Politics: Understanding Georgia’s Redistricting Special Session | Re-elect Doreen Carter | GA District 93
